_description: Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Log excerpt (defanged). Post-compromise actions by the attacker using j.okafor's stolen token.

records._analyst_note: Attacker reads mailbox, searching for finance/AP threads to hijack.

CLASSIC hide-the-evidence rule. Name is a single '.' (near-invisible in Outlook). Auto-files any reply about invoices/fraud/security into RSS Subscriptions, marks read. Lets attacker run BEC undetected while victim never sees warning replies.

Item.Subject: RE: Updated remittance / banking details Q4

records._analyst_note: BEC payload: attacker emails Accounts Payable (a.lindqvist) from the victim's real account to change vendor banking details. Matches the outbound line in the message trace (EV message trace row 7).
Stealth exfil: silent forwarding to the look-alike domain so attacker gets a copy of all replies even if kicked out.
